answer.answer: I walked the `page` cursor to exhaustion for AAPL / revenue: page 1 (offset 0) returned 5, page 2 returned 170, page 3 returned 164 and came back with `next_cursor: null` and `total_count: 339`, so 5 + 170 + 164 = 339 and the walk is complete rather than truncated mid-series. Total points: 339 observations of the `revenue` metric for AAPL. Earliest period: 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29 (obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e, fiscal year 2007, reported as USD 24,006,000,000 from a 10-K filed as accession 0001193125-09-214859). Latest period: 2026-03-29 to 2026-06-27 (obsarch_6685d2b420f3010dbeb6217b, reported as USD 109,417,000,000, the June-quarter 2026 figure from a 10-Q, accession 0000320193-26-000020). Every one of the 339 points carries evidence state SOURCE_REPORTED and validation_status UNVERIFIABLE, so none is cross-validated by a second source. What must be read alongside those numbers: the 339 points are not one continuous measure. They are drawn from three different XBRL concepts and the registry records two series breaks. Up to the 2018-06-30 window the concept is us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet, mapped PARTIAL (a narrower net-sales measure than the metric), with an overlapping window of 2016-09-24 to 2018-09-29 in which us-gaap:Revenues, a wider earning-process measure including investment and interest income, also appears, also mapped PARTIAL. From 2017-09-30 onward us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax is used, mapped EXACT. The earliest point therefore sits under a PARTIAL concept and the latest under an EXACT one, so the two ends of the series are not the same definition. The earliest period is also internally unresolved: two observations share the 2006-10-01/2007-09-29 period and the same source concept but report different values, USD 24,006,000,000 (obsarch_ddb4af888ab3c6be910c0f9e) and USD 24,578,000,000 (obsarch_6383b6a9892d72ff26aab02a), and ST-EVA selected no winner.
uncertainties: The value for the earliest period (2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29) is not settled: two observations for the same period and source concept report USD 24,006,000,000 and USD 24,578,000,000, and ST-EVA records NO_WINNER_SELECTED. I have not chosen between them.

The series spans three source concepts with two recorded CONCEPT_MAPPING_BREAKs: us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet (PARTIAL, to 2018-06-30), us-gaap:Revenues (PARTIAL, 2016-09-24 to 2018-09-29, a wider measure including investment and interest income), and us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax (EXACT, from 2017-09-30). The 339 points are therefore not a single consistent definition, and the two overlapping PARTIAL windows cover the same periods with different concepts.

One point in the walk, obsarch_7429c7068c9299b29190bfba (period 2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30, USD 95,000,000,000, provider YahooFinance, contract_id eval-revenue-vendor), is flagged by ST-EVA as semantic resolved false: no registry mapping relates its concept to the revenue metric, and its own methodology field reads 'evaluation fixture; a value ST-EVA did not retrieve from a source'. It is counted in the 339 but should not be treated as a filed revenue figure. Its period convention is calendar rather than AAPL's fiscal calendar.
All 339 points are validation_status UNVERIFIABLE, a single source each, so no cross-check corroborates any figure in the series.
